scope: All125 source-sized room layouts, with actual0.30m-radius1.70m-height capsule queries and floor support at use/approach plus7points per non-treadmill segment. Actual MultiMesh instances are matched to accepted source-floor equipment by position, scaled rotation and primitive mesh class. Hotel and office rebuilds verify deterministic metadata. This is headless geometry/metadata coverage; actual E activities, raised treadmill mount/dismount, animation and GPU imagery require separate production-controller tests.
